"""Receive this month's supplier CSV through its installed feed client."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        print("usage: python3 tools/receive_stock.py INVENTORY", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    try:
        feed = subprocess.run(["workshop-supplier-feed", "--format", "csv"],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print("Supplier client unavailable: workshop-supplier-feed is not installed.",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 69
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as error:
        print(error.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
        return error.returncode
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="supplier-stock-") as directory:
        incoming = Path(directory) / "stock.csv"
        incoming.write_text(feed.stdout, encoding="utf-8")
        app = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(app), sys.argv[1],
                               "import", str(incoming)], check=False).returncode

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

the inventory application. The supplier client is not included in this checkout
or installed on this development machine. Its installation and authentication
instructions have not yet been supplied. A local sample CSV is available in samples/.
